indexes._comment: history_page.dart menjalankan where(userId) + orderBy(timestamp desc). Firestore menolak query gabungan seperti ini tanpa index komposit, sehingga tab Konsultasi gagal di project Firebase yang bersih. Terapkan dengan: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes

chat_page.dart queries messages with where(userId) + orderBy(timestamp). The userId filter is required by the security rule, and an equality filter combined with an order-by on a different field needs a composite index. COLLECTION_GROUP scope because messages is a subcollection under konsultasi_chat/{threadId}.
